Here is a clean, structured transcription of your whiteboard notes so you can easily drop them into your project tracker or digital brain.

Economics Notes Transcription

Economics Intention: Map scarcity in intuitive, perceptible, manageable way

  • Capitalism: Creativity rules, Natural processes are promoted
  • Communism: Equity rules, Natural processes are demoted

Hybrid: Waves, alternations, 2 games on same board, don't allow enough stagnation for either side down.

  • Pros: * Get a good amount of natural chaos in capitalism
    • Get periodic safety rails
  • Cons: * Rudimentary solution, need more integrated approach
